portal_description:
The NetworkManager-openswan packages contain software for integrating IPsec Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), Openswan and Libreswan, with NetworkManager and the GNOME desktop.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6.8 Release Notes and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6.8 Technical Notes linked from the References section.

Users of NetworkManager-openswan are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
